Join us for another Lisbon Digital Nomads Sunset Social as we gather on **Sunset Destination Hostel, Cais do Sodré\*,** one of the city's best rooftop terraces to enjoy an evening of great conversations, beautiful views, and a laid-back atmosphere. Meet fellow digital nomads, remote workers, entrepreneurs, creatives, and locals from around the world. This is the perfect place to connect. New to Lisbon or already living here for years, everyone is welcome. Come on your own, bring a friend, or join us with your travel group. You'll always find a friendly crowd. **\#\#\# Happy Hour \| 7:30–8:30 PM** 🍻 * 2-for-1 Beer * 2-for-1 Cider We look forward to seeing you on the rooftop for another memorable sunset. **\*Please see photo with the location entrance information.** ***About us:*** We're a group of Nomads, Slowmads, Expats, and Locals who love to meet like-minded people and have a regular meetup running every Thursday since 2017! And the Nomad community is buzzing in Lisbon! Check out our socials to see photos and get updates: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/lisbondigitalnomads/) join our [Slack community](https://lisbondigitalnomads.org/slack) to connect with others! We're all volunteers, these events are not for profit, and we try to find the most awesome ways to connect you on a personal and a professional level. ***Join our team:*** We're currently looking for talented community hosts to join our team. If you think you're up for the challenge of hosting our Thursday meetups and giving back to the community - [please apply to become a host](https://forms.gle/bD388ScQehorr2CH8). We would love to hear from you! ***Do you have a venue for 100+ people indoors? Partner with us:*** We have some spots available for venues that would like to host our Thursday meetups. Our events bring a huge boost in revenue to you on a Thursday night. Get in touch! [Please fill up our venue partnership form](https://bit.ly/ldn-venue-apply) and we'll be in touch with you. Whether you're a nomad passing through Lisbon, staying for a season, living in Lisbon, or are an aspiring digital nomad, you're all welcome to join our events! **📣 Friendly reminder** Our meetups are all about creating a safe, inclusive, and welcoming space for everyone, even as our community grows. Bring your best vibe, treat others with kindness and respect, and make an effort to greet new faces. Remember, everyone has the right to their boundaries—whether it’s a hug, a dance, a drink, or a conversation. Let’s ensure our community thrives by treating each other as we’d like to be treated. Looking forward to meeting you! ***The Lisbon Digital Nomads Meetup Team*** PS - Join our Slack community [here](http://lisbondigitalnomads.org/slack). description: Looking for a fun and friendly way to spend your Friday evening in Lisbon? Whether you live here, recently moved to the city, or you're simply passing through while travelling, you're very welcome to join us! International Friends Lisbon is a growing community of local Portuguese and international people who come together regularly. Most of our attendees stay till 1:00 AM. title: Open Coffee Lisbon #52 - at Folklore Cafe
description: Open Coffee Lisbon is back, and this month we're gathering at ForkLore! These videos show the two routes from the street level to the venue. https://www.youtube.com/shorts/hpPwrXcwNpU https://www.youtube.com/shorts/l18Q649nl7Q Join us on September 29th for Lisbon's friendliest informal networking event. Whether you're an entrepreneur, a freelancer, a student, an expat, or simply someone who loves meeting interesting people, this is your chance to connect with the city's startup and business community. What is Open Coffee? It's an "un-meeting" — no speaker, no agenda, no formalities. Just people who want to help each other. Here's how it works: · We meet at 9:30 sharp · Everyone gets 1-2 minutes to share: · Who they are and what they're working on · What they need (a co-founder, a client, feedback, a mentor...) · How they can help others · After about an hour, the hosting stops and you're free to talk with the people who interest you most Why come? You might find a mentor, an investor, a client, a co-founder, an employer, or a new friend. You might just find the inspiration you've been looking for. Everyone is welcome — and we especially love first-timers. The details: · When: September 29th, 9:30 AM · Where: ForkLore · Cost: a minimum of 1 consumption at the bar. More than just coffee — join the ForkLore community Open Coffee is just one of the ways ForkLore brings people together. Throughout the week, we also host: · Acoustic Jam Session — every Monday 19h30 · Language Exchange — every Wednesday 19h30 · Board & Card Games — every Sunday 19h Come as you are. Listen if you're shy, speak if you're ready. Either way, you'll be glad to meet you. We start at 09:30 AM sharp. Everybody gets up to 2 minutes to present: 1. Who they are and what they are doing 2. What they want 3. How they can help others At 10:30 AM we stop hosting and you can talk to people who are most interesting to you. This event is based on the Open Coffee Krakow format, run by Richard Lucas and others in Krakow Poland since 2012. If you want to help and get involved in making this gathering a regular part of the Lisbon eco-system please let us know [here](https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9) https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9 if you are interested in knowing more about the Open Coffee format, take a look at our video for potential leaders [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z99E2z8anFU). We have events in Cambridge, Krakow, Ericeira, Sydney, Warsaw and soon Tirana according to our format, When you sign up to our events we add you to our [mailing list](https://lisboncommunityevents.substack.com/) https://lisboncommunityevents.substack.com so we can tell you about more free events run by volunteers . If you don't want us to do that don't give us your email. If you change your mind you can leave the Substack mailing list at any time.

title: Open Coffee Lisbon Evening Social
description: Join us for the **Open Coffee Lisbon Evening Social**—a relaxed, welcoming gathering designed for anyone in Lisbon’s vibrant startup and professional community who wants to connect beyond the usual business talk. Hosted by Richard and Naren and the friendly Open Coffee Lisbon team, this event is all about genuine conversations, new friendships, and building a supportive network in a laid-back atmosphere. Many of our current event participants head out for lunch to hang out after our sell out morning meetings. We decided to offer a more social event in fabulous setting. Whether you’re an entrepreneur, student, creative, tourist, or simply curious, you’ll find a space where everyone is encouraged to mingle, share stories, and discover common interests. Our events are open and welcoming to people from all backgrounds and ages. Many different nationalities come together at our events, as well as long term Lisbon residents. Our motto "we welcome all, who welcome all." **This is not a speed dating/pickup type event. Everyone who attends is entitled to feel safe, not be harassed or pressured.** **EVENT STRUCTURE:** We will have a structured first sixty minutes with icebreakers aimed at making things easy for people to connect with one another. Then participants are welcome to hang out and socialise as they wish after the structured part of the meeting is over. **REACH OUT:** If you have a community initiative you want to share or announce, let us know in advance. **VOLUNTEERS** We need volunteers to help us develop the project. From simple things like being early to welcome people, through to PR and graphic design and a website. Let us know if that sounds like you and apply to join the team [here](https://forms.gle/EeLboZcYBrLesVt26) Newcomers are especially welcome, and if you’re feeling shy, don't worry. you’re free to listen or join in at your own pace. Bring your ideas, your curiosity, and your favourite conversation starters. Share your LinkedIn or project links with the group, and let’s help each other grow—personally and professionally. This evening is about making connections that matter, all in a friendly, inclusive setting. If you’d like to help shape future gatherings or feature in our community newsletter, let us know. description: We are back! ☀️💡 After 4 short months that flew by, we are back and we are here to stay! The Lightning Talks format remains the same - anyone can sign up to give a talk, and will have **5 minutes** (strictly timed!) to talk about a topic of their choosing, followed by **5 minutes** of open questions from the audience. The only rule is no pitching of one's business - the ethos of this event is to inspire and educate, it is not a sales opportunity. Please respect this rule. We will have a projector as usual, for any visuals you would like to include in your talk. We want to encourage new people who have never given a talk to try presenting. The bar is low and it's a receptive audience and a great way to wade into public speaking. We are a friendly, and encouraging crowd. We appreciate challenging questions when rooted in genuine curiosity, in an atmosphere of kindness and respect.
